title: pip 隔离模式使 sdist clean-room 约束文件失效
suggestion: 不要通过 PIP_CONSTRAINT 环境变量传约束；像 _isolated_build 一样，在两条 pip install 命令中显式加入 `-c str(constraints)`，并记录 sdist 环境实际安装的构建后端与运行时依赖版本。
rationale: _check_sdist_clean_room 仅在环境中设置 PIP_CONSTRAINT，随后的两条命令却都使用 pip --isolated；pip 隔离模式明确忽略 PIP_* 环境选项，因此 hatchling 和 sdist 运行时依赖实际不受 constraints/dev.txt 约束。定向探针以 PIP_CONSTRAINT 指向 hatchling==0 时，普通 pip 正确报约束冲突，而同一条 --isolated 命令成功解析 hatchling 1.31.0。只要公开索引出现约束文件之外但仍满足 pyproject 范围的新版本，clean-room 就会使用漂移依赖并仍记录 passed，破坏可复现验证。

title: post-checkout hook 可污染声称来自固定 Commit 的发布包
suggestion: 在 worktree add 命令上显式设置 `-c core.hooksPath=<null-device>` 并清理 GIT_* 配置覆盖；构建前再把待打包普通文件及内容与 `git ls-tree`/blob 摘要逐项绑定，而不只依赖 status。
rationale: 这里创建 detached worktree 时继承仓库或全局 core.hooksPath，Git 会执行 post-checkout。该 hook 可修改 snapshot 中的包源码并设置 assume-unchanged（或生成 ignored 文件），随后第 67-69 行和末尾的 `git status --porcelain` 仍为空，两次构建也会对同一污染快照保持 byte-identical。定向复现中 hook 向 src/memoryforge/agent.py 注入标记并设置 assume-unchanged，snapshot status 为空，但构建出的 Wheel 确实包含注入内容；最终 provenance 仍会声明原 Commit 且 worktree_dirty=false。

title: POSIX 本地门禁会把 Git 忽略的源码打进发布归档
suggestion: 不要从调用者的实时 checkout 直接构建；复用 build_release.py 的无 hook 固定 Commit 快照，或在构建前后将 Wheel/sdist 成员和内容摘要严格对齐 `git ls-tree HEAD` 的允许包文件集合。
rationale: 该构建直接读取当前 checkout，而 pyproject 的 Hatch wheel packages 与新增 sdist `/src` include 会无条件收集匹配文件；Git cleanliness、Ruff 等检查均忽略 `.git/info/exclude` 或全局 ignore 命中的文件。定向复现中新增被 Git 忽略的 src/memoryforge/host_only.py 后 `git status --porcelain` 为空，但同一 build 命令生成的 Wheel 和 sdist 都包含该文件。未被固定 Benchmark 导入的额外模块不会使 run_release_check 失败，门禁仍会哈希并发布不属于所报 Commit 的字节。

title: POSIX 本地门禁仍允许宿主包源替换构建后端
suggestion: 为 uv 使用 `--no-config --default-index https://pypi.org/simple`，为 pip 使用 `--isolated --index-url https://pypi.org/simple`，并在子进程环境中移除全部 PIP_*/UV_* 包源变量；发布级约束还应包含分发包哈希或使用只读 wheelhouse。
rationale: uv 分支和 pip 回退分支都继承宿主配置与 PIP_*/UV_* 环境，且 constraints/dev.txt 只固定版本、不固定来源或哈希。配置 UV_EXTRA_INDEX_URL、UV_FIND_LINKS、PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL 或 PIP_FIND_LINKS 后，同版本的替代 build/hatchling 分发包可在构建前执行并产出受影响的 Wheel/sdist；后续 clean-room 与 SHA256 只验证这些既成字节，仍可打印 Local checks passed。新增的 PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME 清理没有关闭这条包源入口。

title: Published acceptance is not bound to the passed-review Commit
suggestion: For every accepted release candidate, require a passed review_evidence object and verify that memoryforge_commit descends from its memoryforge_commit, in addition to the development and local-gate Commits.
rationale: The schema-3 ancestry gate checks only the development Evidence Commit and acceptance_evidence Commit. A focused probe supplied accepted Evidence whose review Commit was explicitly modeled as a non-ancestor; build_benchmark_summary still built an accepted summary and never requested the review ancestry check. If the accepted Registry update and review artifacts are cherry-picked onto a sibling branch from the local-gate Commit, the Registry snapshot check passes on that branch while the published release Commit can omit the exact source Commit covered by final review, authorizing unreviewed source.

title: Malformed final-review findings are treated as non-blockers
suggestion: Validate every finding against the required finding schema and severity enum, require p0/p1/p2 to be real integers, and recompute those counts from the raw findings; for a passed review, reject any malformed or P0-P2 finding.
rationale: The acceptance gate rejects a finding only when finding.get("severity") is exactly P0, P1, or P2. A dict with no severity, lowercase p1, or another malformed value is accepted, and boolean false counts also pass because False == 0. A focused probe confirmed that omitted/lowercase severities and false p0/p1/p2 values all evade these predicates. A malformed producer output can therefore retain a real blocker while the Registry transitions the candidate to accepted_development and opens confirmation.

title: Registry publication does not prove confirmation and holdout results are absent
suggestion: When the release split state is not_run, make Registry validation and summary publication reject either canonical result path if it exists; keep this check in the shared validator used by every publication caller.
rationale: The shared split validator accepts closure solely from the two manifest status fields. Only run_release_candidate_benchmark checks demo/results/release_candidate_confirmation.json and demo/results/release_candidate_holdout.json. The production build caller invokes build_benchmark_summary directly and never invokes that runner. Thus a clean Commit containing a prematurely generated result file while the manifests remain not_run can pass Registry validation and produce benchmark summary and release provenance that falsely claim the split was never run.

title: Summary package version is outside the Commit snapshot binding
suggestion: Read pyproject.toml from the same declared Git Commit as registry.json, and require project.version to equal registry.package_release_target before constructing the summary.
rationale: build_summary validates the Registry against memoryforge_commit but reads package_version independently from the mutable worktree, and build_benchmark_summary does not compare it with package_release_target. A focused call with the valid 0.3.0 Registry and package_version=9.9.9 successfully emitted a schema-3 summary reporting 9.9.9. The CLI's before/after clean checks can also miss a temporary pyproject.toml replacement restored before the second check, so a public summary can claim a package version not present at its declared Commit.

title: Passed review can be attached under the wrong candidate identity
suggestion: Derive the expected candidate label from the bound development Evidence path or revision and compare it exactly with payload.candidate.
rationale: The passed-review validator checks candidate only against a generic numeric regex and never relates the number to development_artifact. For example, a review payload labeled release-development-candidate-999 passes this identity check while being attached to candidate 12, provided its Commit and artifact fields otherwise match. The Commit gates still constrain the reviewed source, so this is not an unreviewed-code bypass by itself, but the accepted public Evidence is attributed to the wrong candidate.

title: PowerShell local-gate output cannot satisfy the release artifact contract
suggestion: Define the expected command and artifact set per platform. For the PowerShell path, accept scripts/check_local.ps1 and register platform-smoke.json in artifact_files, digest fields, SHA256SUMS, and the exact-root closure (or stop publishing that file if it is not part of the contract).
rationale: The new acceptance path requires every platform to claim command scripts/check_local.sh. An actual scripts/check_local.ps1 run necessarily creates platform-smoke.json and includes it in SHA256SUMS, while _validate_bound_gate_artifacts permits only the wheel, sdist, provenance, checksum file, and Code Wiki Evidence and rejects any extra checksum/root file. Therefore an honestly identified PowerShell gate, and even one mislabeled as the shell gate, cannot be registered successfully; the Windows/PowerShell publication path is deterministically rejected.

title: Development Evidence publication silently overwrites an existing result
suggestion: Reject an existing --output path before running, as the workspace drill and release builder do, and write through a sibling temporary file followed by an atomic replace only for a new destination.
rationale: The new runner calls write_text directly without checking whether --output already exists, and it does so before raising for a failed gate. Re-running a candidate against a previous Evidence path can truncate or replace the prior immutable result and then exit with failure; interruption during write can also leave a partial JSON file. Current scripted callers use fresh paths, so this is a defensive publication gap rather than an always-triggered gate failure.

title: Retained package bytes are not bound to the declared Commit
suggestion: Enumerate the Wheel memoryforge/** members and the sdist src/memoryforge/** members, reject duplicate/non-regular members, compare their names and bytes, and bind every packaged source file to the corresponding blob from `git show <commit>:src/memoryforge/...`; also validate the Wheel RECORD.
rationale: _package_archives_match only reads the Wheel METADATA and sdist PKG-INFO and returns true when those two metadata payloads have the expected name/version. It never compares package source members with each other or with the declared memoryforge_commit. A focused probe built a Wheel containing `VALUE = "wheel"` and an sdist containing `VALUE = "sdist"` with identical metadata; this function returned true. Because the surrounding contract validates only digests supplied by the same Evidence, a publisher can update those digests, provenance, and SHA256SUMS and have non-Commit or Wheel/sdist-divergent code accepted as the retained release.

title: Privacy gate accepts Basic credentials in drill metadata
suggestion: Make every retained drill subobject exact-schema, and expand credential detection to sensitive keys such as authorization, credential, cookie, private_key and to common value forms such as Basic, github_pat_, AKIA, and private-key headers; prefer allowlisting publishable fields before serialization.
rationale: The privacy scanner recognizes only api_key/token/password/secret keys and sk-/ghp_/bearer value fragments. At the same time, _release_drill_contract permits arbitrary extra fields inside workspace.restored_lint because it checks only that it is a dict whose status is clean. A focused probe added `"authorization": "Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd29yZA=="`; _payload_private_detail_leaks returned 0 and the complete drill contract still returned true. The credential can therefore be hash-registered and published while Evidence reports private_detail_leaks=0.

title: Drill restore Commit accepts any 40-hex placeholder
suggestion: Bind original_commit to the deterministic frozen drill fixture (or a retained fixture tree digest) and independently verify that restored_commit identifies the same real tree, instead of accepting format and equality alone.
rationale: The workspace contract only requires original_commit to match the 40-hex regex and restored_commit to equal it; it never binds either value to the fixture used by the drill. Replacing both values in the current Candidate 12 drill with forty zeroes leaves _release_drill_contract true. A fabricated or lost workspace can therefore claim backup/restore Commit equality with an identity that never represented the tested workspace.

title: Drill citation provenance accepts arbitrary source identities
suggestion: Recompute the expected source_id and wiki page identity from the frozen drill fixture/evidence text, then require those exact values in the citation, verified evidence, top-level fields, and page path.
rationale: The answered-query contract checks only that source_id is any 64-hex string, copies consistently across fields, and that wiki_pages contains any 12-hex directory. A focused probe replaced every source_id with 64 zeroes and the page directory with 12 zeroes in both original/restored results; the complete drill contract still returned true. The retained Citation can thus be internally consistent but unresolvable and unrelated to the source that produced the answer.

title: Candidate 2 的失败终审被绑定到 Candidate 3 Evidence
suggestion: 将 Candidate 2 static-review sidecar 绑定到 revision 3 的 Candidate 2 development Evidence，并让该条历史状态显式反映 review failed；Candidate 3 不应携带自称属于 Candidate 2 的 review_evidence。
rationale: revision 4 的 development path 是 release_candidate_development_candidate_3.json，但其 review_evidence payload 自报 candidate=release-development-candidate-2，review Commit 433f33c 也是 Candidate 2 local-gate Commit 926832e 的直接后继、早于 Candidate 3 development Commit 5005f15。当前 accepted_development_superseded 状态绕过 review-state 一致性检查，schema 3 因而会把 Candidate 2 的失败终审嵌入 Candidate 3 Evidence，破坏历史状态与 sidecar 的候选身份绑定。

title: Candidate 2 static-review scope 无法从固定 Commit 重放
suggestion: 为 Candidate 2 保留包含 base_commit、source_commit、完整 diff/review 统计的 review-scope sidecar，并像 Candidate 5-11 一样调用 _git_diff_stats 从固定 Git 范围复算后校验。
rationale: Candidate 2 的 retained review 只声明可变的 origin/main...HEAD，既没有 base/source Commit 和统计字段，也没有 review-scope artifact；该分支随后只做 Commit 祖先检查，从未调用 _git_diff_stats。结果是 Validator 能接受这份 5 个 P1、1 个 P2 的失败终审，却无法证明当时实际审查了哪些文件和行。

title: Passed-review consumer 接受 malformed finding 并仍声明零阻断项
suggestion: 严格校验 raw/top finding 的完整 JSON schema 和 severity 枚举，按 raw findings 重算 p0/p1/p2；通过态应要求两份 finding 列表均不含任何合法 P0-P2，未知或缺失 severity 必须 fail closed。
rationale: 当前逻辑只拒绝 severity 精确等于 P0/P1/P2 的对象，不校验 finding 字段或计数一致性。定向探针把 raw_findings 和 top_findings 都写成 {"title":"hidden blocker","severity":"p1"}，同时 review.p1=0，_validate_release_static_review_acceptance 仍返回成功；因此损坏或非规范化的 review sidecar 可授权 accepted_development。

title: Passed review 的 candidate 标签未绑定到 development Evidence
suggestion: 从 development_artifact.evidence_revision/path 推导期望 candidate，并要求 payload.candidate 精确相等；同时约束 review artifact 路径属于该 candidate 的固定目录。
rationale: 接受路径只要求 candidate 匹配任意正整数正则，没有与正在转入 accepted_development 的 development_artifact 建立身份关系。定向探针为 Candidate 12 的 development/local-gate 链提供 candidate=release-development-candidate-999 的 passed review，其他 Commit、scope 和 artifact 条件满足时仍返回成功，机器记录可据此把另一候选标签的终审作为当前候选的授权 Evidence。

title: Raw Code Wiki evidence is validated against the current suite instead of its declared Commit
suggestion: Load demo/evaluation/code_wiki_eval.json with `git show <gate_commit>:demo/evaluation/code_wiki_eval.json`, then derive the expected suite SHA256, suite name, and case identities exclusively from that snapshot.
rationale: The local-gate producer creates Code Wiki evidence at gate_commit, but this retained consumer derives the expected suite hash, name, and cases from REPO_ROOT in the later Registry checkout. A focused probe changed only the current suite name and bytes, updated the retained payload to that post-gate suite, and left memoryforge_commit=f16d2735009519929e82e250668a72877986aed1; _raw_code_wiki_evidence_contract still returned true even though `git show f16d2735:demo/evaluation/code_wiki_eval.json` had SHA256 e2253d9c... and the accepted suite had SHA256 d5b544ac.... A future suite update can therefore make later suite semantics appear to have been executed at an older gate Commit (and can also invalidate honest historical evidence). The current suite still matches the gate snapshot, so this is a defensive identity gap rather than a presently triggered release failure.
